    productID="LC08_C02_L1"
)

# 读取夏季影像
summerImage = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="LC08_L1TP_119038_20220728_20220803_02_T1",
    productID="LC08_C02_L1"
)

winterRed = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(winterImage, ["B4"])
winterGreen = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(winterImage, ["B3"])
winterNir = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(winterImage, ["B5"])
winterSwir1 = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(winterImage, ["B6"])

winterNdvi = service.getProcess("Coverage.rename").execute(winterNdvi, ["Winter_NDVI"])

# 冬季 GNDVI: (B5 - B3) / (B5 + B3)
winterGndvi = service.getProcess("Coverage.normalizedDifference").execute(winterImage, ["B5", "B3"])
winterGndvi = service.getProcess("Coverage.rename").execute(winterGndvi, ["Winter_GNDVI"])

# 冬季 NDMI: (B5 - B6) / (B5 + B6)
winterNdmi = service.getProcess("Coverage.normalizedDifference").execute(winterImage, ["B5", "B6"])
winterNdmi = service.getProcess("Coverage.rename").execute(winterNdmi, ["Winter_NDMI"])

# 选择夏季波段

summerSwir1 = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(summerImage, ["B6"])

summerNdvi = service.getProcess("Coverage.rename").execute(summerNdvi, ["Summer_NDVI"])

# 夏季 GNDVI: (B5 - B3) / (B5 + B3)

summerGndvi = service.getProcess("Coverage.rename").execute(summerGndvi, ["Summer_GNDVI"])

# 夏季 NDMI: (B5 - B6) / (B5 + B6)

    "palette": ["brown", "yellow", "lightgreen", "green", "darkgreen"]

import oge
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# Winter image
winterImage = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="LC08_L1TP_119038_20230104_20230111_02_T1",
    productID="LC08_C02_L1"
)

# Summer image
summerImage = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="LC08_L1TP_119038_20220728_20220803_02_T1",
    productID="LC08_C02_L1"
)

# Winter bands
winterRed = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(winterImage, ["B4"])
winterGreen = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(winterImage, ["B3"])
winterNir = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(winterImage, ["B5"])
winterSwir1 = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(winterImage, ["B6"])

# Winter NDVI
winterNdviNumerator = service.getProcess("Coverage.subtract").execute(winterNir, winterRed)
winterNdviDenominator = service.getProcess("Coverage.add").execute(winterNir, winterRed)
winterNdvi = service.getProcess("Coverage.divide").execute(winterNdviNumerator, winterNdviDenominator)
winterNdvi = service.getProcess("Coverage.rename").execute(winterNdvi, "Winter_NDVI")

# Winter GNDVI
winterGndviNumerator = service.getProcess("Coverage.subtract").execute(winterNir, winterGreen)
winterGndviDenominator = service.getProcess("Coverage.add").execute(winterNir, winterGreen)
winterGndvi = service.getProcess("Coverage.divide").execute(winterGndviNumerator, winterGndviDenominator)
winterGndvi = service.getProcess("Coverage.rename").execute(winterGndvi, "Winter_GNDVI")

# Winter NDMI
winterNdmiNumerator = service.getProcess("Coverage.subtract").execute(winterNir, winterSwir1)
winterNdmiDenominator = service.getProcess("Coverage.add").execute(winterNir, winterSwir1)
winterNdmi = service.getProcess("Coverage.divide").execute(winterNdmiNumerator, winterNdmiDenominator)
winterNdmi = service.getProcess("Coverage.rename").execute(winterNdmi, "Winter_NDMI")

# Summer bands
summerRed = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(summerImage, ["B4"])
summerGreen = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(summerImage, ["B3"])
summerNir = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(summerImage, ["B5"])
summerSwir1 = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(summerImage, ["B6"])

# Summer NDVI
summerNdviNumerator = service.getProcess("Coverage.subtract").execute(summerNir, summerRed)
summerNdviDenominator = service.getProcess("Coverage.add").execute(summerNir, summerRed)
summerNdvi = service.getProcess("Coverage.divide").execute(summerNdviNumerator, summerNdviDenominator)
summerNdvi = service.getProcess("Coverage.rename").execute(summerNdvi, "Summer_NDVI")

# Summer GNDVI
summerGndviNumerator = service.getProcess("Coverage.subtract").execute(summerNir, summerGreen)
summerGndviDenominator = service.getProcess("Coverage.add").execute(summerNir, summerGreen)
summerGndvi = service.getProcess("Coverage.divide").execute(summerGndviNumerator, summerGndviDenominator)
summerGndvi = service.getProcess("Coverage.rename").execute(summerGndvi, "Summer_GNDVI")

summerNdmiNumerator = service.getProcess("Coverage.subtract").execute(summerNir, summerSwir1)
summerNdmiDenominator = service.getProcess("Coverage.add").execute(summerNir, summerSwir1)

summerNdmi = service.getProcess("Coverage.rename").execute(summerNdmi, "Summer_NDMI")

    "min": -1,
    "max": 1,
    "palette": ["blue", "lightblue", "green", "yellow", "red"]

    "max": 1,
    "palette": ["brown", "yellow", "lightgreen", "green", "darkgreen"]
}

summerGndvi.styles(vis).getMap("Summer GNDVI")

winterNdmi.styles(ndmiVis).getMap("Winter NDMI")
summerNdmi.styles(ndmiVis).getMap("Summer NDMI")

# Center map
